Zuko Nonxuba

By: Tarryn Crossman | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

Unique Selling Point:
As South Africans it’s like we’ve almost become numb to corruption or people stealing millions from the government.
But this time it’s different, Nonxuba is not just allegedly stealing from the state, he is stealing from these desperate special needs children, taking money meant to give them a fighting chance at LIFE, and using it to make himself richer and richer and richer.

Summary:
In early 2016 investigative journalist Sabelo Skiti wrote what he thought would be a Christmas story about how the grinch of Christmas, Litigation Lawyer Zuko Nonxuba, stole a RAF plaintiffs’ money.
But it turned out to be so much bigger than that, his story fueled an SIU investigation into Nonxuba, who to date has been awarded nearly a half million rand by the WC and EC DOH, with hundreds of thousands of it unaccounted for.

For nearly a decade Nonxuba has managed to evade the arms of the law, but as the net finally starts to tighten, we put all the building blocks of his illustrious scam together, to give a holistic picture that will leave even the most cynical South African shocked.

Nonxuba painted himself as a brilliant litigation lawyer for the people, going into underprivileged communities and offering to help families with disabled children, and in many cases he did. He got huge medical negligent pay outs for children with CP, and he in some cases he paid the money over to the plaintiffs. But it appears that he was also trying to scam poor, illiterate moms with disabled children, so that he could make millions for himself.

Modus operandi varied, but what we can prove is that he would get touts to go into the community and find him families with special needs children. He would then create totally fraudulent medical negligence claims in their names, that they were not even aware of, whether some of these cases were awarded money from the DOH we can’t say, but we have the facts about the few that were stopped by the SIU in the EC and the WC DOH.

When he wasn’t creating fraudulent claims and the plaintiff actually won their case against the department, what we can prove is that he was then either opening a trust and only paying them a tiny percentage and claiming the rest on exorbitant legal fees, which the LPC reprimanded him for. Or there was never a trust opened, and he would simply pay the plaintiff a small amount of cash and maybe a monthly amount like 2k for “groceries”. These plaintiffs were largely unaware of how much they had been awarded, which in most cases was 5million up.



Further information:
Case studies:
FRAUD
Pamela Q:
Tout approached her and said she knows a guy that can help her with her child.
She meets with Nonxuba and he promises to get her a wheelchair for her son.
He takes notes from her medical records, which clearly state that she gave birth before getting to the hospital
He submits a summons, fabricating where she gave birth and that her child landed up with CP due to - its a standard list of negligence reasons that he uses on all his claims.
Next meeting Nonxuba coaches her to lie and says he will come back with a wheelchair.

Mfana
Nonxuba looked at her medical records too, which clearly state that her son had down syndrome. He them submited a summons stating that the child had CP from medical negligence - same list of reasons why
Then he was asked by the department to explain why and he submited a new claim stating that it was an error, but the department were still liable due to the fact that they didn't send her for testing so that she could choose to abort before 23 weeks. Also false, as she only went to the clinic for the first time at 6 months
SIU Picked up on all the fraud cases because they were a carbon copy of each other, so he was copy and pasting

REAL CASE: NO TRUSTS EVER SETUP
Millicent was awarded 15 million for her CP child avile molose in June 2019
The court ordered Nonxuba to open a trust in the childs name within 6 months
In October 2022, that trust has still not been opened - masters office affidavit
Nonxuba paid her 50k directly into to her personal account and then every now and again he sends her grocery money.

REAL CASE: trust set up, but only paid the plaintiff 10% of the actual amount owed
Willovale - awaiting more details

Script:


ACT 1

I first came across the story. around Christmas time in 2015
I remember, you know, the cynical journalism in me was like, Oh, wow, I can actually pitch this for the Christmas diary.
It was like the Grinch Stole Christmas

VO 1: Sunday times journalist Sabelo Skiti thought he was writing a ONE-off article about a YOUNG MAN WHO’D BEEN cheated by a dodgy litigation lawyer from the Eastern Cape… but it WOULD BECOME SO MUCH MORE.

This guy, a client of Nonxuba’s Said If you just took the time to look at villages, they are littered with this guy's victims. That was the thing that sparked it for me.
I knew that then I had to go to these villages.

VO 2: WHAT SKITI DIDN’T KNOW at the time WAS THAT HE had just broken a story that would lead to a decade investigatiNG the allegedLY criminal activities of THE litigation ATTORNEY…. Zuko Nonxuba.

BEHIND THE SCENES

VO 3: Working for the Special Investigating Unit at the time, the press articles piqued the interest of an investigator we will call Sarah. To protect her identity.. and safety… Sarah’s words are repeated by an actor.

His name kept on coming up in the Sunday times and the daily dispatch. the articles were talking about medical negligence, suspected fraud and maladministration
So we did our own follow up investigations, identified those cases, and found that everything in the articles were true

VO 4: The Special investigating unit HAD BEEN seconded to the eastern cape to investigate the province’s medical negligence CRISIS ADDING UP to billions of rands..AND ONE of the lawyers the THE SPOTLIGHT FELL ON… was Nonxuba.

The plaintiffs would tell us they got 200,000 rand or 230,000 thousand rand for their Cerebral palsy child, yet we are sitting with a court order that's awarded them 23 million or 16 million.
And these guys had no idea.



00:02:47:15 - 00:03:28:09
these were kids that had been born with cerebral palsy because of, you know, that torturous conditions in some of the hospitals in in the former Transkei
He particularly targeted those villages, because he knew that theSE people are desperate.

VO 5: Cerebral Palsy CAN occur when a baby is starved of oxygen IN THE first few minutes of ITS life.
IT CAN BE AVOIDED WITH proper medical care…BUT South Africa HAS AMONG THE HIGHEST PROPORTION OF CP BABIES IN THE WORLD.. DUE TO INADEQUATE RESOURCES AND SKILLS…IN state hospitals.
THis MEDICAL NEGLIGENCE EPIDEMIC HAS createD the perfect BREEDING ground for money-hungry litigation lawyers… like Nonxuba

SEGUE INTO CHARACTERS
VO 6: After HIS traumatic, 5-day LONG delivery, at a state hospital …Nobathembu Katshele’s son, Zubenathi, started having seizures STRAIGHT AWAY.
3:49 – 4:24
ndayozibuzela ngo Mgqibelo ukuba lomntana ucimele akabonakali na xa ehleli akabonakali na xa evukile kodwa unale ngalo ndabuza ukuba “lengalo itheni?” yathi iNesi eyandiphendulayo lomntana uyaxhuzula oko ebephumile nje uvele waxhuzula.
I went to ask why the baby was always closing its eyes, I couldn’t even tell whether he was asleep or awake. The nurse told me that the baby had a seizure from birth.
VO 7: Zubenathi would later BE diagnosed with Cerebral Palsy
My child is so fragile. The child looks like he is 1 month old even though he is already 12 months old.
VO 8: In 2013 Nobathembu was spotted by one of Nonxuba agents…this is standard practice for dodgy litigation lawyers…even though it is illegal, they send OUT scouts to villages, clinics and hospitals to LOOK FOR clients.

HE was paying people in villages to recruit mothers with cerebral palsy children and we suspect nurses that also may be stealing files to sell

VO 9: Nobathembu and her son Zubenathi were then taken by Nonxuba’s men to see doctors in GQEBERA and Johannesburg… their medical records were copied and they were TAKEN home. It was almost a year BEFORE she heard from Nonxuba again

He then called me to high court in Mthatha
He first said the money I am going to received is going to be 3 million that was in 2014
He further told me his job was done and that we would not be meeting with me anymore

VO 10: KEPT IN THE DARK.. Zubenathi’s mom had no idea that her son had won a 12.4 million rand medical negligence payout, which was paid to Nonxuba inc in 2014….

VO 11: Nonxuba had been given 6 months by the court to open a trust in Zubenathi’s name - it is a special kind of account, managed by independent trustees, in order to keep people’s money safe.
But when Skiti arrived at the family’s home DURING HIS INVESTIGATION..IT was two years later…YET they hadn’t received a cent and knew nothing about ANY trust.

In the case of Zuma, absolutely nothing that had been done, his mother actually was suffering because she was taking public transport, taking him to a public hospital. And that money was for that express purpose to make sure that it looks after his medical needs in the now and going into the future.

VO 12: Medical NEGLIGENCE litigation is big business…that is crippling an already broken state health system. To date Nonxuba has been paid out over 600 000 million rand in potentially FRAUDULENT medical negligence claims against the department of health.

VO 13: as The SIU investigation intensified, sarah and her team found evidence that Nonxuba was not only NOT paying out on legitimate claims, but he was also submitting completely fraudulent claims.

We started comparing and so many of these summonses were basically identical, same amount, same
lay out, the same merits. So he wasn't even bothering to make them unique to each patient.

VO 14: Pamela Qendwana is a single mom who lives out here alone with her cerebral palsy daughter Avuzwa…she can’t work or even travel far from home, as her daughter needs 24 hour care

Upsound from them

VO 15: In 2014 while collecting her daughter’s DISABILITY grant money pamela was randomly approached IN THE QUEUE by someone claiming to know a lawyer who could help with her child

I got asked do I need help for my child with a wheelchair, I said yes and she said she would take my number and give it to Mr Nonxuba

VO 16: Even though Pamelea’s daughter HADNT even BEEN born in a hospital, Nonxuba traveled all the way out here to SIGN HER UP.. AND COLLECT her details SO HE COULD SUBMIT a medical negligence claim against the state

He then took photo copies of our clinic card then a copy of our ID’s and then our birth certificates, he took everything

VO 17: WITHOUT Pamela’s KNOWLEGDE, Nonxuba SUBMITTED A BOGUS CLAIM FOR … 16 AND A HALF MILLION RAND CLAIM against the eastern cape HEALTH department…WHICH WAS INTERCEPTED BY THE sPECIAL INVESTIGATIng UNIT

According to the summons, which is drafted by Nonxuba, she gave birth in in the hospital
But the medical records show that BBA, which is born before admission. In other words, you walked into the hospital with the child. So the summons is false.

VO 18: Pamela’s case was one of 6 fraudulent medical negligence claims that the SIU discovered in only a few months

These women are also his victims because he gives them hope, he makes them promises to get grants, schooling for these children and medical care. From the word go, he lies to them.

VO 19: While these fraud investigations were underway, Nonxuba continued to win millions against the Eastern Cape department of health.
HAVING PERFECTED HIS METHODOLOGY/MODUS OPERANDI, he spread his wings to the Western Cape, targeting the same clientele: desperate MOTHERS OF cerebral palsy BABIES from poor areas

The Western Cape had 93 medical negligence cases lodged for the whole province against them, 53 of which were NONXUBA
33 matters of the 53 that were referred for criminal prosecution.
How far the matters are, I don't know.

VO 20: The HAWKS TOLD US that AN investigation INTO THE NONXUBA has begun…BUT we were shocked to DISCOVER that almost 5 years since THEY STARTED, Nonxuba had not been charged?

00:18:08:09 - 00:18:12:03
CLAIRE
Did you ever in that time get to speak to someone in the.
00:18:12:21 - 00:18:44:13
Our one interaction with him
Before we published the first story, it didn't go very well.
We found that he was a very evasive person.
00:18:44:15 - 00:19:04:11
SUNDAY TIMES
I think he was someone who was not used to being held accountable. And he certainly gave me that posture

VO 21: As our investigation into Nonxuba escalated and we traveled deeper into RURAL EASTERN CAPE, IT became OBVIOUS that these families FELT so intimidated by THE FANCY lawyer in a SHINY suit that many of them FEARED THAT THEY had actually done something wrong… not Nonxuba.

You’ve got innocent, poor semi-literate people that you can exploit and that was what he did he's exploited them

travel or something.. here we need to pick up the intensity

VO 22: We get a TIP-OFF that THE FRAUD MAY GO even deeper…WE ARE SHOWN multiple cases where Nonxuba had won millions from the department of health… WITHOUT PAYING OVER THE MONEY INTO the children's trust accounts

To verify the allegations we DRIVE to Willowvale…WHERE Millicent Molose SHOULD HAVE BEEN THE RECIPIENT OF A R15 million PAY-OUT for her son…

I think I met Mr Nonxuba in 2015 or 2016.
He said he was from Nonxuba Attorneys and his job was to assist children living with disabilities
he then promised that he would build a house for my child

VO 23: Millicent’s son Avile was diagnosed with CP due to birth injuries at a state hospital, she was aware that Nonxuba was submitting a medical negligence claim for him, but she was never told the amount of the claim.
The last time she heard from Nonxuba was in 2019

I was told that the case has been closed and he then gave me R50 000.00

VO 15:Even though the evidence was overwhelming we made the decision not to tell millicent about the 15 million rand payout, until we could confirm where the money went

VO 24: in the meantime we took the tretorius two hour journey back to Millicents village where her son lives during the week, while she works in town

it is not easy,
I want my child to go to school, I want him to have a wheelchair, I want him to feel good

when we finally arrived at HER home… Millicent was completely shocked shocked to find her son…COMPLETELY alone

UOSOUND

VO 26: He’S IN a terrible state, lying in his own vomit, overheating… battling to breathe.

Upsound – breathing

VO 27: Millicent’s voice literally quiverS as she trieS to reassure her son that he’S okay.

Upsound – blowing him and saying shhhh its okay

It hurts everyday when I go to him
I can feel it when he is not feeling well

Im sorry upsound

VO 28: Leaving Millicents village that evening all I kept thinking was how does someone steal from this child! I was devastated and outraged

Driving

VO 29: A few days after Skiti’s article in 2016, Nonxuba opened a trust in Zubenathi's name. This was two years after the court order, but again there was no consequence for Nonxuba

He called me in 2016 and told me that the money was out by 2014 and it was 12 million But there was a delay so I will only get 8 million

VO 30: Accountant James phillip davison is a co-trustee on Zubenathi’s trust AS WELL AS ON 11 OF Nonxuba’s other clients’ ACCOUNTS…
TOGETHER WITH OTHER TRUSTEES, THEY SHOULD have Flagged irregularities with these trusts by now
OUR producer TRACKS him down while on Safari


I think it was in 2014. Um. I commenced work with Nong Nova
I would be involved from the beginning in actually registering the trust at the master's office.

VO 31: As a trustee it is Davisons job to ensure that Nonxuba pays over all the capital as per the court order, and that the trust is then solely used to benefit the child

Normally what happens? The attorney would have a contingency fee agreement with the client, and the contingency fee agreement would allow the attorney to take the lesser of 25% of the award or double his normal fee.
tarryn 00:18:27:04 - 00:18:34:10
It looks like he's taking in the region of 60 to 70%,
00:22:28:18 - 00:22:59:08
he would often pay over a random amount of, say, 2 million. And then the next day another million. claiming that he had limits on his bank transfers,
And then that's when we would say,
00:23:00:01 - 00:23:12:07
What's happening? And he says,. I will provide you with a full accounting summary, and the accounting summary never comes through.

Is it possible, in your mind, to say the trustees were not aware of what was going on?
Look, you would have to try very hard to convince me of that. For instance, a person like Philip James Davison is a chartered accountant
So the court order says there must be 12 million rand in this trust. If the lawyer or the attorney deposits 6 million for argument's sake. That's the first thing that would be red flags for you as a trustee, Where's the full amount?
davison
from the beginning. The trustees have queried the amount paid by Onuba and you follow up and nothing happens

VO 32: IT WAS SHOCKING to hear that it had taken davison and his co-trustee almost 6 years to take action against Nonxuba
We eventually had a summons issued about a month ago, which was successfully delivered.
and he has put in a notice to oppose. which is again another delaying tactic which could set us back another couple of months.

VO 33:
WITH EVIDENCE IN hand, we SIT Millicent down TO show her WHAT THE COURT HAD REALLY AWARDED HER SON…THE DOCUMENT NONXUBA FAILED TO SHARE WITH HER: 15 million rand was HERS SONS …NOT 50 000 as HE had told her.

She is totally shocked … yo yo yo
Heybo…
13 million
Yo …
Where is the money now?
That amount has been paid to Mr Nonxuba
This guy has kept too much money

VO 34: Millicent has NOW reported her case to the police, but unless Nonxuba has a change of HEART.. OR A CRISIS OF CONSCINECE… it WOULD be a long legal battle for her to recover her sons money

Wow Mr. Nonxuba
I am speechless
I just don’t know
I don’t know what’s going on

link As South Africans it’s almost like we have become numb to corruption or scammers stealing millions from the government. But this time it’s different, nonxuba is not just allegedly stealing from the state, he is stealing from these desperate special needs children, money meant to give them a fighting chance at LIFE and using it to make himself richer and richer and richer.

VO 35: As this investigation went on I kept thinking it couldn’t get any worse, but it did.

In 2021 treasury did an audit into Nonxuba Inc, which exposed a potential shortfall of 263 million rand. This was state money that had been paid to Nonxuba to better the lives of these Cerebral Palsy children and it had vanished

VO 36: In an email from his lawyer Nonxuba denied all the claims against him or refused to comment as the matter was still in court. Unsatisfied with his response we tried to confront him at his offices in Johannesburg
all the numbers we had for him were also either off or no longer existed. SO I guess all we can do now is WAIT that the wheels of justice finally start turning.

SUI - SURELY HE CAN’T JUST GET AWAY WITH IT

VO 37: IN 2022 Nonxuba was found guilty on three counts of fraud against the ECDOh, But before he could be sentenced the magistrate was killed in a car accident.
The trial started from scratch in March this year
Nonxuba will also appear in the East london court on another 3 counts of fraud

ACT 3

VO 38: After a long drawn out process the legal practice council finally managed to suspend Nonxuba last year, but he has contested his suspension in the constitutional court. So he continues practicing, having rebranded himself as an international Arbitration lawyer from Sandton
there's that saying to understand the society, look at how it treats its kids and its elderly
And those were the people that Nonxuba targeted the most vulnerable of people in society,
And instead of doing right by them,

He stole from them and not only from them and from the country

metadata.Unique Selling Point: As South Africans it’s like we’ve almost become numb to corruption or people stealing millions from the government. But this time it’s different, Nonxuba is not just allegedly stealing from the state, he is stealing from these desperate special needs children, taking money meant to give them a fighting chance at LIFE, and using it to make himself richer and richer and richer.
metadata.Summary: In early 2016 investigative journalist Sabelo Skiti wrote what he thought would be a Christmas story about how the grinch of Christmas, Litigation Lawyer Zuko Nonxuba, stole a RAF plaintiffs’ money. But it turned out to be so much bigger than that, his story fueled an SIU investigation into Nonxuba, who to date has been awarded nearly a half million rand by the WC and EC DOH, with hundreds of thousands of it unaccounted for. For nearly a decade Nonxuba has managed to evade the arms of the law, but as the net finally starts to tighten, we put all the building blocks of his illustrious scam together, to give a holistic picture that will leave even the most cynical South African shocked. Nonxuba painted himself as a brilliant litigation lawyer for the people, going into underprivileged communities and offering to help families with disabled children, and in many cases he did. He got huge medical negligent pay outs for children with CP, and he in some cases he paid the money over to the plaintiffs. But it appears that he was also trying to scam poor, illiterate moms with disabled children, so that he could make millions for himself. Modus operandi varied, but what we can prove is that he would get touts to go into the community and find him families with special needs children. He would then create totally fraudulent medical negligence claims in their names, that they were not even aware of, whether some of these cases were awarded money from the DOH we can’t say, but we have the facts about the few that were stopped by the SIU in the EC and the WC DOH. When he wasn’t creating fraudulent claims and the plaintiff actually won their case against the department, what we can prove is that he was then either opening a trust and only paying them a tiny percentage and claiming the rest on exorbitant legal fees, which the LPC reprimanded him for. Or there was never a trust opened, and he would simply pay the plaintiff a small amount of cash and maybe a monthly amount like 2k for “groceries”. These plaintiffs were largely unaware of how much they had been awarded, which in most cases was 5million up.

She meets with Nonxuba and he promises to get her a wheelchair for her son. He takes notes from her medical records, which clearly state that she gave birth before getting to the hospital He submits a summons, fabricating where she gave birth and that her child landed up with CP due to - its a standard list of negligence reasons that he uses on all his claims. Next meeting Nonxuba coaches her to lie and says he will come back with a wheelchair. Mfana Nonxuba looked at her medical records too, which clearly state that her son had down syndrome. He them submited a summons stating that the child had CP from medical negligence - same list of reasons why Then he was asked by the department to explain why and he submited a new claim stating that it was an error, but the department were still liable due to the fact that they didn't send her for testing so that she could choose to abort before 23 weeks. Also false, as she only went to the clinic for the first time at 6 months SIU Picked up on all the fraud cases because they were a carbon copy of each other, so he was copy and pasting REAL CASE: NO TRUSTS EVER SETUP Millicent was awarded 15 million for her CP child avile molose in June 2019 The court ordered Nonxuba to open a trust in the childs name within 6 months In October 2022, that trust has still not been opened - masters office affidavit Nonxuba paid her 50k directly into to her personal account and then every now and again he sends her grocery money.
